release.methodology_note: This candidate contains physical and economic context, DESNZ PAT survey observations, plus classified UK MP post counts when the Junkipedia bundle is present. News and Bluesky attention remain unavailable. DESNZ PAT observations are weighted response shares from irregular survey waves, not daily attention. MP counts measure communication volume, not enacted policy, and do not include engagement counters. MODIS raw NDVI and greenness anomalies use a UK calendar-month 2001–2020 baseline; FIRMS detections are not wildfires; market closes are exploratory context. Associations do not establish causality.

source_snapshots.notes: Met Office HadUK-Grid country area average; provisional files may be revised.

NASA MOD13C2 v061 monthly NDVI; country means are latitude-area-weighted over valid 0.05-degree cells. Greenness anomalies use the UK calendar-month 2001–2020 baseline carried forward from the old Wildfire-Trends pipeline.
Free catalogue of major events. Events are filtered to configured country ISO3 mappings; unmatched countries remain in event metadata.
NASA FIRMS VIIRS_SNPP_SP world-area windows; low-confidence and non-vegetation detections are excluded, and detections are aggregated to configured country-days.
Current Environment Agency flood warnings and alerts for England; this endpoint does not provide historical daily backfill.
NASA MODIS MCD64A1.061 Burn_Date native-projection rasters converted to daily UK burned hectares; zero-burn days are retained when covered.
Official DESNZ weekly UK average pump prices; revisions are possible.
ONS CPI time series MM23; ONS revisions and release vintages are retained at raw-response level.
FRED daily Europe Brent spot price; values are market context, not UK pump prices.
Exploratory daily market closes. Confirm Yahoo Finance redistribution terms before publication.
Aggregate classified MP post counts imported at day grain; engagement counters are excluded.
DESNZ Public Attitudes Tracker aggregate time-series workbook; values are weighted response percentages. Low values are retained as missing.
